text: {"features":[{"name":"Role tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter explains why this exact Google Information Security Engineering role is a strong match.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could plausibly be sent to many software jobs, with only minimal mention of Google, information security, or the team's actual work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in security or infrastructure and may name Google, but the connection to this particular role remains broad."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Links the applicant to at least one clear responsibility or trait of the role, such as security automation or backend systems, but tailoring is still partial."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects the applicant's background and goals to several specific elements of the role or team, making the application feel intentionally targeted."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a highly specific case for this exact opportunity by tying the applicant to Google, the Information Security Engineering context, and the role's mix of security automation, Go backends, and Python agents."}]},{"name":"Mission understanding","description":"How well the letter demonstrates a nuanced grasp of the team's security-engineering problem space.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes security in generic terms and shows little understanding of how this team scales security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Recognizes that the role involves security tooling or automation, but the description stays high-level and generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Accurately describes one important part of the mission, such as vulnerability triage, lifecycle embedding, or automating manual security work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains several mission elements, such as multiplying scarce security expertise, assisting developer teams, or treating vulnerability response as a systems problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep understanding of the team's charter by articulating how agents, infrastructure, triage, and broader analysis can systematically scale security coverage."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How strongly the letter values foundational work whose benefits propagate across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses mostly on personal interest or single-product work, with little sense of organization-wide leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions impact in broad terms but does not clearly emphasize central or foundational engineering."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that infrastructure or platform work is appealing because many other teams build on it."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames impact in terms of downstream teams inheriting improvements and values habits associated with central platform work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes multiplier effects through foundational infrastructure a defining motivation and clearly links that motivation to this role."}]},{"name":"Partner orientation","description":"How well the letter presents security engineering as work done in service of security specialists and developer teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about helping other engineers or partnering with security practitioners."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies support for others, but the letter mainly centers on the applicant's own technical interests."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly mentions helping developer teams, working alongside security engineers, or reducing manual partner workload."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames security tooling as a way to reduce friction, return expert time, or make secure practices easier for partner teams to follow."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently presents the applicant as a service-minded builder who wants to collaborate with security specialists and make the secure path the easy path for busy engineers."}]},{"name":"Production depth","description":"Strength of the professional track record testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Establishes only minimal or lightly developed production experience, with limited tenure or a small amount of shipped-system responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some real production background across testing, maintenance, or launches, but with limited breadth or repetition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid production experience through several years of work and multiple services taken through the software lifecycle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production depth through repeated launches or long-term maintenance responsibility across several services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production maturity, combining long tenure, repeated launches, and explicit lessons drawn from keeping systems healthy in production."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows relevant experience building systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Names Go without indicating real depth, ownership, or what was built with it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States that Go is used regularly, but gives little sense of the kinds of systems built in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a primary language and ties it to production services or backend work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Go ownership through concrete backend, infrastructure, or guardrail systems described in the letter."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go a clear professional strength through multiple concrete examples of building or operating important backend or security-adjacent systems in it."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows substantial Python experience relevant to tooling, automation, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it only in passing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python for occasional scripting or general familiarity, with little depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for automation, analysis, internal tools, or service prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Python as a significant engineering tool for production-grade services, tooling, or agent implementations."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major strength tied to multiple role-relevant uses, such as automation layers, internal services, and AI or agent systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"Evidence of strong practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of algorithmic skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic ability in general terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of using a better data structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clearly consequential algorithmic reasoning in production design or optimization beyond a generic claim."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic fluency a clear differentiator through specific examples showing the applicant selected or designed structures and algorithms that materially changed system behavior."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"Relevance and maturity of experience building with AI or language-model systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or broad exposure without describing shipped or hands-on work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on work with AI or language-model features in production or near-production settings."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Pairs shipped AI work with evidence of evaluation, guardrails, or learning about failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong AI maturity by describing delivered model-backed systems and how they were engineered for reliability, constraint, or safety in practical use."}]},{"name":"Agentic design","description":"Experience designing systems where agents act autonomously within explicit controls.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or autonomous tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agentic systems loosely without explaining how they were designed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling at a functional level, such as agents carrying out multi-step tasks."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains architectural controls such as contracts, permissions, boundaries, or auditability around agent behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of agentic architecture, with a clear separation between agent logic and the infrastructure or guardrails that constrain it."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Evidence of automating intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related vulnerability-response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to security automation in broad terms without describing the workflow automated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct work automating vulnerability report intake or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains meaningful workflow details such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or measurable workload reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability-response automation as a major accomplishment with clear ownership and several pipeline elements automated to materially reduce expert manual effort."}]},{"name":"Security assessments","description":"Depth of hands-on experience performing security reviews or assessments of systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of actually performing security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals general security awareness but not hands-on review work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience performing security assessments, reviews, or threat modeling in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Specifies methods such as attack-surface analysis, code review, threat modeling, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial assessment depth through repeated hands-on review work and clear evidence that findings informed real design or release decisions."}]},{"name":"Security signal","description":"Strength of extra evidence that the applicant actively develops security skill outside ordinary software work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no external security signal beyond ordinary work claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows light additional signal, such as occasional security practice or a more introductory certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid additional signal, such as recurring CTF participation or one meaningful security credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong extra commitment through high-level adversarial practice or a demanding hands-on credential."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals, such as elite or frequent offensive practice plus a demanding practical credential, making sustained security engagement unmistakable."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"How strongly the letter signals careful, reliability-oriented engineering standards suited to security-sensitive systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little concern for correctness, reliability, or engineering discipline beyond generic competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions quality or seriousness broadly but without concrete practices or examples."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Indicates care for correctness or dependability with at least one relevant practice, example, or design principle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides concrete signs of rigorous engineering, such as guardrails, typed and tested tools, validation checks, or a maintainer's mindset."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes high standards and dependable behavior a defining theme, supported by multiple concrete practices appropriate for security-critical tooling."}]},{"name":"Independent initiative","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant pursues substantive engineering work beyond assigned job duties through side projects or open-source ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes no meaningful side project or open-source work outside normal employment."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal tool or one-off project with limited scope or sustained ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows steady outside engagement through a maintained side project or occasional upstream fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial ownership through a nontrivial system or an open-source project with external users or contributors."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional sustained ownership of a complex side system or actively maintained open-source project with real users, releases, or significant architectural decisions."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete and verifiable the letter's claims are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad assertions of skill or fit with little concrete evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics such as years, tools, or employers, but most claims remain unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with concrete examples of systems, tasks, or responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly backs claims with specific examples and at least some implementation detail."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes nearly every major claim tangible through precise examples, ownership details, and clearly observable technical facts."}]},{"name":"Impact articulation","description":"How clearly the letter explains the practical results of the work it describes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes activities or skills without saying what changed because of them."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints that the work was useful but gives little concrete sense of effect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States general results such as faster systems, reduced toil, or improved routing without much detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains clear effects on reliability, performance, workload, or partner teams, even if not fully quantified."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes impact vivid through specific consequences, measurements, or strong before-and-after framing that shows why the work mattered."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How well the letter organizes qualifications into a clear, persuasive story rather than a loose list.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as disconnected statements or requirement-matching fragments with little flow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure, but transitions are weak and the case for fit feels stitched together."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a coherent case for fit with recognizable structure and some thematic continuity."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Develops a strong throughline that connects motivation, experience, and role fit in an easy-to-follow progression."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a memorable, well-paced narrative in which the opening idea, supporting evidence, and closing case reinforce one another."}]},{"name":"Mechanical polish","description":"Accuracy and professionalism of spelling, grammar, and surface-level editing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent typographical or spelling errors that distract throughout and noticeably reduce credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible surface errors, though the letter remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a few minor errors, but they do not materially disrupt reading."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and professional with at most an occasional minor slip."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and clearly carefully proofread."}]}]}
